verdict.rationale: LanceDB documents a dedicated hybrid search mode that combines multiple search techniques. It pairs BM25-based full-text search with vector search, and a reranker step is shown in the hybrid search workflow to merge and rank results. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the fusion method (e.g., RRF or weighted linear combination), a single-call hybrid query example combining vector and keyword inputs, sparse-vector support, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can combine dense vector search with keyword or sparse (BM25-style) signals in one hybrid query with fusion ranking

citations.quote:
This is an example of **hybrid search**, a query method that combines
multiple search techniques.
LanceDB provides support for Full-Text Search via Lance, allowing you to incorporate keyword-based search (based on BM25) in your retrieval solutions.
Use a reranker to improve search relevance.
